native_product_capabilities.optional_install: native console install route runs installation behind the request and exposes progress/failure status
native_product_capabilities.explicit_activation: runtime preference remains auto|builtin and installation is never performed implicitly by XiaoYu
native_product_capabilities.acp_stdio: native AcpConnection handles JSON-RPC request/notification lifecycle, timeout, late reply drop, process exit and cancellation
native_product_capabilities.permission_convergence: dsh guard and host capability gateway converge on the NekoClaw host permission authority
native_product_capabilities.credential_isolation: provider model name/key are injected by host loopback forwarding; credentials are not handed to dsh
native_product_capabilities.session_mapping: native runtime records the selected runtime/session and resumes the same runtime when valid
native_product_capabilities.fallback: readiness/session-open/incompatibility failures fall back to built-in with a recorded user-visible reason
native_product_capabilities.cancellation: native runtime abort/close/process cancellation paths are covered
native_product_capabilities.restart_recovery: native dsh sessions can resume in a new dsh process; removed/unrecoverable dsh sessions restart on built-in according to host policy
native_product_capabilities.capability_parity: host report/search/fetch/subagent tools and capability gateway are exposed through the native MCP service
native_product_capabilities.version_compatibility: native exact version pin and install integrity checks reject incompatible on-disk runtime

selected_machine_acceptance: ACP timeout drops a late answer instead of applying it to a newer request

runtime abort stops the active turn and queued work
session resumes in a new dsh process without reconstructing a second XiaoYu session authority

model requests remain session-scoped and host-forwarded
pinned dsh denial precedes host approval

nothing is uploaded by profile construction

whatever prevents dsh from working still lets the commission complete on built-in

allowed: select existing pinned N.E.K.O tests in the existing private-overlay GitHub Actions gate
add overlay contract tests that prevent accidental removal of that acceptance coverage

acceptance_environment.note: Selected tests use N.E.K.O's native fake dsh/fixtures and exercise production runtime code without installing or activating the optional runtime.

retirement_condition: Retire the overlay dsh acceptance selection when pinned N.E.K.O upstream CI exposes an equivalent mandatory optional-runtime product suite covering ACP lifecycle, readiness/fallback, host permissions/MCP, credential isolation, cancellation/restart, version compatibility and console readiness, and XiaoYu can invoke that suite directly without reducing coverage.
conclusion: REUSE_NATIVE_ONLY. The supported dsh seam is already product-architected inside N.E.K.O; XiaoYu should add machine acceptance coverage, not another runtime implementation.
